nodes.label: ar_subs — Arabic subtitle system
nodes.rationale: End-to-end pipeline: auto-fetch Arabic subtitle then auto-align. Three sources tried in order (offline Subscene index first for zero-quota LAN-fast lookup, SubSource preferred online, SubDL last-resort). Episode matching, season-pack unpacking, and per-season search cache are shared by all three sources.

nodes.label: autosubsync — automatic subtitle timing
nodes.rationale: Embedded text subtitle preferred (one windowed ffmpeg pass, dialogue-only filtered, sub-to-sub ffsubsync) because it is more reliable; bounded audio VAD is the fallback (capped window, serialized-speech cache). Offset+scale cached per episode so replays apply in ~20 ms; next episodes' refs prefetched in background; implausible alignments (cues past end-of-media = wrong release) rejected instead of loaded.

nodes.label: Offline Subscene index (Docker FTS5 API)
nodes.rationale: Optional Docker API (subtitle-api/, not in this repo) over a ~306k-subtitle FTS5 index of the Subscene Arabic dump. Checked first: zero quota and LAN-fast, avoiding online API limits.

nodes.label: SubSource.net — preferred online subtitle source
nodes.rationale: Preferred online source (SUBSOURCE_API_KEY): per-season show resolution and episode-filtered pack ranking.

nodes.label: SubDL — last-resort subtitle fallback
nodes.rationale: Last-resort fallback (SUBDL_API_KEY) using TMDB/TVDB metadata for title/season/episode detection.

nodes.label: zstd-compressed subtitle cache (~/.cache/mpv)
nodes.rationale: Subtitles stored compressed at rest (.ass.zst/.srt.zst, zstd-19 via in-process LuaJIT FFI — no subprocess) under one cache root, decompressed into an LRU hot/ dir on load in sub-milliseconds. All regenerable state under one root so deleting it gives a clean start.

nodes.label: [Anime] auto profile
nodes.rationale: Swaps in the Anime4K chain as a replace (not stack); HDR sources excluded; height-gated so 4K falls back to the SSim chain instead of upscaling pointlessly.

nodes.label: anime_detect.lua — anime classifier
nodes.rationale: Classifies via TMDB Animation genre + Japanese original language so western animation (Pixar/Arcane) stays off the Anime4K path; /Anime/ folder path also triggers. Reads TMDB_API_KEY straight from the environment.

nodes.label: SmartSkip — Opening/Ending/Preview auto-skip
nodes.rationale: From awesome-mpv (stax76): auto-skips chapters after a 3 s cancelable countdown; silence-based skip (?) covers unchaptered files.

nodes.label: Dynamic crop
nodes.rationale: Uses the native C++ sidecar in cuda-crop-cpp/ (ffprobe + ffmpeg cropdetect — no Python). Installer tries to build it automatically; requires CMake, a C++17 compiler, nlohmann_json, and ffprobe/ffmpeg at runtime.

nodes.label: cuda-crop-cpp executable target
nodes.rationale: C++17 (CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17, extensions off), strict warnings (-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic), CMake >= 3.20; builds src/main.cpp into the cuda-crop-cpp sidecar binary.
